title: Retire the outpaint LoRA - and give the Character Sheet flow its own answer
description: flux2-klein-4b-outpaint is deprecated: LanPaint replaces the fill/removal path it was baked in for (MPI-602), and Fabio removed it from the bench template 2026-08-22. Retiring it is NOT one deletion. It has a second consumer with nothing to do with inpainting - flow_character_sheet.json node 708 loads it at strength 1.1 - and that flow (MPI-504, shipped) needs a real replacement, not a removal. Fabio has authorised the eventual R2 and HF delete; the ordering is the constraint. There is also no 9B equivalent of this weight, so the 9B arm has no outpaint LoRA at all.
